title: Cerebras CEO says we’re nearing a future where everyone has a personal AI assistant at home
script:
Cerebras Systems Chief Executive Officer Andrew Feldman predicts personal AI assistants will soon inhabit every home.
Andrew Feldman states these dedicated helpers will become as common as traditional household appliances.
The processing architecture will split tasks between local hardware units and remote cloud servers.
Cerebras Systems previously focused primarily on giant wafer scale processors for enterprise data centers.
This shift brings high performance computing directly into daily consumer environments.
Would you keep a personal AI assistant in your house?
